notes.title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite - What Is Early Access?
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/3ef554769a853e1a2be9e345f19ebebe1bf14990.png"][/img][b]

Hello everyone,[/b] [/h3][p]We’re excited to share some news on [u][b]Call to Arms: Panzer Elite[/b][/u] & what you can expect with Early Access. Before diving in, we’d like to set the stage by explaining who we are, what [u][b]Call to Arms: Panzer Elite[/b][/u] is (and isn’t), and what you can expect going forward. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Who We Are[/b] [/h3][p][b][u]Digitalmindsoft[/u][/b] is an independent studio whose roughly 25, mostly veteran developers share a great passion for tactical and immersive combat gameplay. Starting with [b]Men of War[/b] (2009) and both [b]Men of War: Assault Squad[/b] titles (2011 / 2014), we were finally able to establish our own IP with [b]Call to Arms[/b] (2018).  [/p][p]Together with our brothers in arms at [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/barbedwire"]Barbed Wire Studios[/url], we co-developed [b]Call to Arms: Gates of Hell[/b] (2021), utilizing over 15 years of experience and continuous improvements in it. We are deeply grateful for our ongoing partnership, and while development on Gates of Hell progresses independently, there will be continued opportunities for collaboration and shared expertise as both projects move forward. [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/8969234914679b1768a3954dea30997578883fb7.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What Early Access Means[/b] [/h3][p]Early Access means the game is still in development and not yet in a finished state. Bugs and incomplete content will be present, but this is the perfect opportunity to help shape the game's future. [/p][list][*][p]New features will be added, and existing features will be improved. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Content, including new tanks, missions, and maps, as well as game balance, will evolve throughout development. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Your feedback will directly influence the development path and priorities. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We want to work closely with the player base during Early Access to shape the game’s direction for years to come. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]If you’re new to Early Access games, we recommend checking out streams and let’s play videos to get a feel for what to expect. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/178e19f0968b74bbe7f8d4876a80bb56c834f0db.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]What Call to Arms: Panzer Elite Is[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]A first-person / third-person tank combat game set during the intense armored battles of World War II, focusing on historically accurate tanks and units used in the period. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Maps are inspired by real historical events and battlefields, aiming to recreate authentic environments and tactical challenges. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A “simcade” experience, balancing realism such as real penetration mechanics and historically accurate gameplay with quality of life options and a strong focus on fun to make it accessible. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Includes singleplayer, cooperative, and multiplayer modes, allowing you to command your tank platoon across varied scenarios. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Features destruction physics that can dynamically alter the battlefield, with destructible environments impacting strategy and gameplay. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Features the option to toggle less realistic features on or off to tailor the experience to your preference. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3] [b]What Call to Arms: Panzer Elite Is Not[/b] [/h3][list][*][p]A fully realistic WWII tank simulator. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A real time strategy title. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A clone of other popular WW2 tank games, nor are we aiming to compete with them. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A pay to win game. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A purely pvp multiplayer focused game. (we offer coop and a singleplayer experience on top!)[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/1722c2378ba9131a5206f6c481232b02fd148ced.png"][/img][i]"Overhead view of Campaign Mission Schöneberg"[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]When Is Early Access[/b][/h3][p]We will have additional info in the coming days so stay tuned! [/p][p]  [/p][h3][b]Call to Arms: Panzer Elite Pricing[/b][/h3][p][b][u]Standard Edition[/u] - $29.99[/b] [/p][p][u][b]Deluxe Edition Upgrade[/b][/u][b] - $19.99[/b] [/p][p][u][b]Supporter Bundle [/b][/u][b]-[/b] [b]$49.98 - 10% ([/b]includes both Standard & Deluxe Edition)[/p][p]
We will offer a [b]Supporter Bundle[/b] at [b]10% off[/b] for those who wish to contribute even further to the game’s development and it already includes the [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] upgrade!

You may ask why we are releasing a DLC during Early Access. The reason is simple: we are already planning and working on a [b]Deluxe Edition[/b] for the full release, and we believe it would be unfair to withhold content from our early supporters who are already helping us during this phase.[/p][p]To be transparent about our plans, the DLC is available at a reduced price during Early Access, and some of its content is already included for you to enjoy. Our philosophy is that the earlier you support us, the less you should have to pay for the game.[/p][p]To make things even better, Early Access will launch with an [b]additional 10% discount[/b] during the first week!
[/p][p][u]Price can vary from region to region[/u]  If you purchase during Early Access you own the game during & after Early Access.    [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Roadmap Plans[/b] [/h3][p]Instead of locking ourselves into rigid promises now, we want to listen to your feedback first to help shape the game’s development. We’ve already heard from our testers and are working on quality of life improvements such as a [b]checkpoint system[/b], [b]bug fixes[/b], [b]balancing adjustments[/b], [b]more missions[/b], [b]additional tanks[/b], [b]new maps[/b], and [b]polishing existing systems[/b] and assets like [b]sounds[/b].
[/p][p]There will be many updates in the coming days / weeks after launch with fixes and changes. The game is in active development and we plan to work with the community along the development path. We will have more detailed roadmap plans shortly after launch.[/p][p]Please don’t feel pressured to buy the game right now if you’re unsure about its current state. Early Access means the game is still evolving, so it’s perfectly okay to wait until it’s more polished or has the features you want. There’s no rush take your time and join us when it feels right for you. If you’re uncertain whether the game fits your playstyle or expectations, we recommend checking out streams and videos from content creators to get a clearer picture before deciding.
[/p][p]This is the beginning of a journey we’re embarking on together. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts and see how the game evolves with your involvement. Thank you for supporting us and joining us in Early Access! [/p][p]See you on the battlefield! [/p]

notes.title: Dev Diary: Maps & Creating the Battlefield
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/8a1d7a0b67346c0c2711a8ec50bae0960048015b.png[/img]

[b]Hello Tank Commanders![/b]

Welcome back to another installment of our dev diary series for [b]Call to Arms: Panzer Elite![/b] [p]Today, we’re taking you behind the scenes of one of the most challenging and rewarding parts of development: [b]map production[/b]. Every battlefield you fight on has a story, and creating those maps is where history, research, and gameplay all collide. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/9635e0a5ccad367e3f07b636b45e8dc18a83187f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]
Research Comes First[/b] [/h3][p]Our process always begins with research. From famous operations to smaller but equally dramatic engagements, we look for moments in history that can inspire compelling missions. Archival photos, maps, veteran accounts, and even on-site visits all shape the foundation of a map. [/p][p]But we also learned early on that reality doesn’t always fit inside our maps. Technical limitations mean we can’t reproduce every hill, town, and valley of a real battlefield at full scale. Many locations cover vast areas, full of unique challenges and details that simply wouldn’t fit into a single level. [/p][p]Instead, we distill the essentials of the terrain. We take the most interesting features -the chokepoints, ridges, crossroads, and strongholds - and bring them together into one playable area. This way, players can experience a wide variety of tactical challenges inside a relatively compact battlefield, without losing the authentic feel of the original location. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/9a4a859529b759f26f2c128eee4d61e1fb5808a4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]
From History to Gameplay[/b] [/h3][p]Take our Mortain mission as an example. The real battle in August 1944 was defined by German forces attempting to recapture the heights around the town. Instead of focusing on the town center, we decided to highlight the surrounding high ground and a railway station - a setting that naturally creates choke points, ambush sites, and room for armored maneuvers. [/p][p]This balance of authenticity and design freedom gives us both the atmosphere of Normandy and the intense gameplay you expect from the tank battle game. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/986cad1b406f7efc14682c4581e5a3684f361e15.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]
Walking the Ground[/b] [/h3][p]To truly capture the feel of these locations, our team even traveled to Normandy. Standing on the ridges, walking through the bocage, and visiting Mortain itself gave us invaluable perspective. Photographs can only take you so far - experiencing the terrain in person helps us recreate the mood and flow of the battlefield in a way that feels real, not artificial. [/p][p]During these trips, we also took hundreds of reference photos of landmarks, terrain, and structures. From bridges to old farmhouses, many of these details found their way directly into the game. Whenever you cross a narrow bridge under fire or push through a hedgerow, chances are it was inspired by something we stood in front of and documented ourselves. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/c9cb7dcfce05c337a6321ec9cfd0eeccdd4db448.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/7897bdf2cdd1decde481960b3284548ef1891c99.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]
Iteration, Iteration, Iteration[/b] [/h3][p]Map design doesn’t happen overnight. Early sketches are tested, refined, and sometimes completely rebuilt. We brainstorm, block out terrain, and playtest repeatedly until the battlefield feels just right. Each map goes through multiple iterations before it reaches the balance of historical inspiration + engaging gameplay. [/p][p]To support this process, we’ve built our own set of tools. These allow us to quickly block out interesting positions for the player, populate the battlefield with life, and shape the environment so it feels authentic. On top of that, we developed entirely custom mission tools that let us control the flow of each scenario - from the pacing of enemy attacks to the timing of reinforcements. Together, these systems help us transform a rough sketch into a living, breathing battlefield. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/dcb73613649a84ab8569cb6a3a6fcfc20b2ade20.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/2774998828e2b0996c11f96580b06686e100d4fe.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]
 Experiencing It All[/b] [/h3][p]Of course, all this effort - the research, the trips, the tools, the iterations - has one goal: to create a battlefield you can truly feel. We want every map to be more than just a stage for combat; it should be an experience that puts you into the boots of a tank commander. Whether you’re holding the line on a ridge, ambushing through the bocage, or storming across that bridge we photographed, the aim is for you to live history while shaping the outcome yourself. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/8fb3746babf3b1bd60b2905b0ec5b23863ba1aa8.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/1151db72f3c511df6c49f57eaf0008f657e49336.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45657808/1f565b42a1507f9dc8afc5aeeb650bc86e007c73.png"][/img][/p]

[h3][b]What’s Next?[/b] [/h3][p]Thanks for sticking with us! We can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on and to appreciate the battlefields firsthand. Every trench, ridge, and farmhouse was crafted with care to challenge your tactics and immerse you in the struggle of World War II. [/p][p]See you on the battlefield - and as always: Happy tanking! [/p]
